calls.description: Independent calls; each has its own result or error.

wait_ms.description: The longest the sidecar holds the response while the job is queued or running. It answers as soon as the job is in any other state (for example completed, ready_for_review, awaiting_approval or failed), and otherwise reports the current state when the wait elapses. The sidecar honors at most its discovered `jobs.maxWaitMs`.
